content: {"like":["Improved camera and sound quality","Better production values and special effects","Alternate song presentations and stronger performances on Disc 1","Tiffany and Taeyeon's Lady Marmalade performance","Jessica's solo showcasing vocal and instrumental skills","Overall improvement over the first Asia Tour DVD","Disc 1 considered excellent and worth the price for fans"],"dislike":["Packaging quality lower than previous DVD, thin main case, photo book not secure","Missing English language option in menu and subtitles","Interlude segments less humorous","Disc 2 pacing issues with too many hits early and weak closing songs","Limited and short special features","Overall concert rated only 5/10"]}
